name: imfaisii-skills
description: Faisal Ashfaq's personal marketplace of Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: commit-crafter
plugins.description: Write clear, conventional git commit messages from your staged changes. Inspects the diff, infers the right type and scope, and proposes a tidy message.

plugins.name: pr-describer
plugins.description: Generate a structured pull request description from your branch diff: summary, what changed, why, and a review checklist.

plugins.name: eeat-blog
plugins.description: Research keywords and write a comprehensive, EEAT-optimized SEO blog post inside an existing repo's blog system, with images generated by the Deeporax (Grok Imagine) connector.

plugins.name: nextjs-skeletons
plugins.description: Add loading.tsx and component-matched skeletons to a Next.js app for faster perceived navigation, fixing and adding skeletons on data calls while mirroring the app theme, dark mode, and accessibility with zero layout shift.

plugins.name: claude-design-local
plugins.description: Reproduce claude.ai/design output from Claude Code. Ships the real call order, the intake gate that decides when to ask about aesthetics, the canvas patterns found in real web exports, local .dc.html preview with no cloud round trip, and hooks that turn the two silent failure modes into hard denials.
